title: nbn 25/10 $48.99/Month Ongoing, 500/50 $59.99/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) & Free eero 7 with 24-Month Plan @ Arctel
body:
Deal: nbn 25/10 $48.99/Month Ongoing, 500/50 $59.99/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) & Free eero 7 with 24-Month Plan @ Arctel

[itsfree] So after June 2027, the Cruisy Lite plan will increase in price? If so, will we be able to terminate the Free Eero contract without an early device payout fee?
[Team Triforce] @itsfree - It may increase (likely to be transparent) but will be minimal, this plan is designed to be an on-going affordable price, without promotion discounts.
The modem payout is calculated based on your remaining term. Unfortunately it can’t be free!
[sprof] Nice but https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/964234
[Team Triforce] @BatmanAU - We are aggregating on the Superloop network for majority of our locations, so you get all the benefits of Superloop backhaul network & our own international network 👍🏽
[BatmanAU] Nice, can you future book, as i cant get it at this moment, early next month??
[Team Triforce] @BatmanAU: Appreciate the feedback, we are here to help! Thanks for giving us a shot :)
[itsfree] @Team Triforce: That's great - so the ARC-F&F promo would also still apply then?
[Team Triforce] @itsfree: 100%, it’s live & we are seeing orders flowing in! Signup today & activate within 30 days.
[Twix] New to the NBN? We have a $100 discount on the NBN New Development Fee, down to only $200! This offer is only valid till the 30/06/2026, so do not miss out!
Is the expiry for this 17 July?
[Team Triforce] @Twix - Fixed, extended till 31/07/26! I don’t think there is any other provider offering a discount on the new installation cost?
[akma1] How much is the modem if cancel before 24 months please
[Team Triforce] Modem cancellation is based on the RRP of $300, by the amount of remaining months. Example below if that helps, otherwise all in the CIS.
12/24 x $300 = $150, assuming you leave after 12 months.
[BeefBiryani] your website suggests the modem price as $109.
[Team Triforce] That’s the on-sale promotion price currently. You can buy the modem outright for that price 👍🏽
[dealmaker] remove the cgnat removal additional $5 cost and i will likely bite
[Team Triforce] Would love too… but it’s becoming so hard & expensive to get new addresses. We are working on a dynamic IP solution … but no timeline at present!
[polhena] Is Dynamic IP not an option at this time?
[Team Triforce] Unfortunately not, default is CG-NAT, with the option for a static IP ($5 p/Month).
[BargainHunterD] Did everyone who was overcharged by Arctel get their refunds?
[Team Triforce] 100%, was definitely some delays in moving the billing back over to our in-house team, but everyone has been refunded.
We have been around for years, not running away with anyone’s $50 😎
[carpecrash] Was with these guys for 6 months when they first started. Constant drop-outs and also unplanned outages. Would not bother again
[looks] Same here. The amaysim offer seems a lot better.
[itsfree] Amaysim was the biggest nightmare I've ever dealt with. There's no way I would ever recommend them even if they paid me to join.
[Team Triforce] @carpecrash - Out of all the negative feedback, nearly none are about the performance (excluding Brisbane POP), the drop-outs is definitely not a known issue, the frequent PLANNED OUTAGES which did bring interruptions of 5-10 minutes were critical network upgrades, which is part of on-boarding thousands of new customers a month! Happy to review your individual service & see if there was any other reason for your bad experience.
[carpecrash] Really? That's a dangerous game you're playing. See the screenshot below of my inbox of the number of interruptions I was notified of. And these are only the reported ones:
https://files.ozbargain.com.au/upload/8823/130503/screenshot…
[Team Triforce] Hi @carpecrash, those are the “planned outages” we mentioned above. Where you were notified in advance for works being carried out.
The window was always after midnight to avoid interrupting as many customers as we can, but is also aligned with multiple parties including data centres, cables, engineers & other teleco’s.
We have always aimed to be as transparent as possible, do what you wish with the information.
If you want to lend some advice on running an ISP we are all ears!
[thedavemiester] Been with these guys for 6 months, has been stable with zero issues. Wish the Brisbane pop would hurry up though
[Team Triforce] @thedavemiester - It is our top priority, unfortunately with the delay in getting more public IPV4 address we are a bit hamstrung. We are working with APNIC to expedite the request. We appreciate your patience!
[looks] Had so many issues with this ISP. I would not recommend.
[Team Triforce] Thanks for sharing @looks, it’s unfortunate you feel that way & we don’t always get it right. If you are happy to DM me your service ID / issues, we will work with you to resolve.
[Team Triforce] Not as yet, struggles with NBN around service assurance. It’s something we are looking into! Sorry.
[jv] nbn 25/10 $48.99/Month
$36 with Superloop for 6 months
[Team Triforce] Sure is, but if you signup with an eero 7, you’re stuck paying their on-going price of $78 for the next 30 months, or in month 7 you pay $40 more then our plan… which is everything you saved the first 6 months.
Providing internet services as an ISP is not free, all these promotional prices are loss leaders, for a company to be sustainable we eventually need to make a profit.
Our plans are marketed to be competitive commercial, technically on par with the market leaders & reward on-going loyal customers.
In the current market if you wish to move providers every 6 months, you will likely always find a cheaper deal, but with the NBN CPI increases, I would be watching out for when the market stops & prices rise.
Obviously you’re free to determine wether you’re looking for a bargain for 6 months, or a few years :)
[Team Triforce] Also showing as $58.00 online, but I’m assuming you’re referencing a promotion somewhere?
[Endless Winter] Sadly still on FTTN, you guys don't offer 100/40 plans?
[Team Triforce] We offer the 100/20, for the same price as the 500/50. If you search your address up, it will automatically downgrade you to the 100/20 if you have a FTTN location.
We don’t sell the 100/40 as a plan unfortunately!
[Endless Winter] Thanks for the quick response!
Yeah I saw that, I like having 40 upload tho :(
I know its not you, but sucks that us still stuck on FTTN is being punished pricewise, feels like ADSL days, the Have's and Have not's.
[Team Triforce] Sign up & DM through your service ID. We will activate you on 100/40 for no additional cost for as long as you stay!
[Endless Winter] @Team Triforce: That's a great offer sir.
One sticking point, I am with Superloop, so have to give 30 days notice is all. But I see above you guys are going to honour 30 day period?
Do we sign up and tell a date for switch?
You guys use Superloops backbone right? (ACT, Queanbeyan)
[Team Triforce] @Endless Winter: Yep, you can choose an activation date 30 days in advance & we do use the SL for backhaul to your local POI.
Cheers,
Hus
